data.explanation: This letter from the research institute confirms you have a place in the summer research programme. You need to sign the enclosed participation form and send it back by the date stated in the letter (07/08/2026); the institute says forms arriving later cannot be considered. Please note that today's date is already after that deadline, so you should contact the International Study Office immediately to check whether a late submission can still be accepted, quoting the reference number GMRI/ST/2026/118. No payment is requested in this letter.
